scope: Shared policy for new cases/rounds under DEC-048; never a case-specific requirement list.

environment.page_javascript: enabled; task-specific restrictions belong to explicit case policy

static_state.scroll: top unless the Evidence requires another position; below-fold objects are not absent
static_state.focus: none unless the Evidence requires focus
static_state.animation: freeze or exclude from static measurements
static_state.stability: wait for fonts and verify relevant layout/style stability; fixed delay alone is not proof

dynamic_state.driver: real browser action declared by the Evidence
dynamic_state.settling: bounded stability wait; record actual times and timeout
dynamic_state.recovery: mandatory only when the source Requirement requires it
dynamic_state.missing_target: resolution failure alone is not proof of model absence

measurement.color_alpha: do not ignore alpha or layered appearance; use reliable painted-color evidence or Judge
measurement.rem: convert using captured root font size; do not assume 16px
measurement.ratios: compare measured pixels against ratio * captured reference extent using pixel tolerance
measurement.precision: retain exact versus approximate source wording even when using the same measurement error policy
measurement.qualitative: Judge or unsupported; no thresholds inferred from GT
measurement.individual_overrides: none active; DEC-025 proposed thresholds are not adopted

font_policy.default: unrestricted font family choice unless input specifies a font
font_policy.specified_font: must actually render; declaration alone is insufficient
font_policy.unavailable_font: record resource evidence; environment/unknown failure is UNRESOLVED

resource_policy.external_page_stylesheets: not allowed; page CSS remains embedded
resource_policy.permitted_resource_unavailable: UNRESOLVED when evaluator/network failure or origin unknown; no automatic model FAIL

severity_definitions.light: 局部偏差；主要内容仍可识别，主要操作仍能完成
severity_definitions.medium: 明显偏差；影响部分内容呈现、布局关系或操作体验
severity_definitions.severe: 条件整体缺失、关键内容不可辨认，或要求的交互无法完成

scoring_policy.same_requirement: sum the deductions of distinct failed Evidence
scoring_policy.missing_dimension: the other applicable dimension has weight 1
scoring_policy.single_attribution: One direct fact, one deduction: Gate/Evidence and Evidence/Evidence duplicates keep their verdicts, deduct 0 and name the owner.
scoring_policy.unresolved: no deduction; mandatory UNRESOLVED blocks the formal score
scoring_policy.severity_unresolved: a FAIL without a validated severity is never imputed and blocks the formal score
scoring_policy.judge_source: record the Judge and severity source; use one Judge type for all models in a batch
scoring_policy.confirmed_model_dependency_failure: FAIL each affected mandatory condition; each failed Evidence deducts its own severity; no root-cause deduplication
scoring_policy.missing_mandatory_evidence: Evaluator failure or unknown cause: UNRESOLVED; no formal score. Confirmed model dependency failure: FAIL under DEC-029.
scoring_policy.legacy_requirement_formula: retired by DEC-038 (2026-10-18); historical results only, never recomputed or reported for new runs
out_of_scope: appearance score (Codex 0-10 and human 1-5) - not part of the score

output_contract.scope: Newly prepared cases and rounds; historical frozen versions retain their original contract.
output_contract.case_prohibitions: Only explicit input.forbidden or separately recorded user scope may narrow permissions; preserve the source and freeze it with the case. Do not add new Evidence from GT.
output_contract.font_expectation: Use any font unless input specifies one; specified fonts must actually render. Do not inherit the old generic-only font ban.
output_contract.resource_failure: Evaluator/network/collection failure or unknown cause is UNRESOLVED; confirmed implementation failure is assessed against the owning Evidence. Permitted resources are not blanket gate failures.
not_implied: permission implies a requirement to use JS or remote resources

implementation_status.reason: Policy-bound preparation and runtime enable inline JavaScript and observe remote fonts/images. Font stylesheet permission requires complete supported CSS evidence; unknown evidence remains UNRESOLVED. Synthetic browser and legacy isolation tests passed; each release still requires environment preflight and GT validation.
